pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, multi-lobed dark regions with soft, diffuse pixel gradients at the edges. Patch geometry transitions from larger, roughly rectangular blocks on the neck to smaller, more jagged, stellate shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways forming high-frequency junction nodes. Pixel thickness is greater on the upper neck and narrows into a fine, intricate web on the mid-to-lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the neck and upper shoulder, characterized by small, pointed pixel clusters of low amplitude against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A visible discontinuity in the mane profile occurs at the transition point between the cervical and thoracic vertebrae where the dark pixels terminate abruptly.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced skeletal topography along the spine and scapula creates significant localized shadowing, distorting the 2D perception of the pelage pattern.
